fill_rule: Sult takes part of the goal celebrations: each real monthly goal hit (about one a month) earns a goals:* sticker. The newest one always goes on 'celebration-table' (the month's celebration, under an extra warm glow at night); the one it replaces moves to the free slot with the lowest 'order' (the ledge spots, then the floor). Italian dishes learned at Sult (dishes:italian, 'Inspired at Sult') show on 'pass' (the chef's special: the dish just learned, under the middle pendant); the previous one moves to 'board'. If every ordered slot is full, the oldest sticker leaves the room (it stays in the book). Draw stickers after the base, sorted by y then x.
